### The Beast from the Earth
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-beast-from-the-earth
Passage: Revelation 13:11-12
Points:
- Satan actively schemes by creating counterfeits of holy things to draw people away from God.
- The beast from the earth exercises false signs and religious deception to compel worship of worldly powers.
- Rulers throughout history have partnered with false religion and compromised teachers to consolidate authority against God's church.
- Believers frequently face economic coercion and must discern deceptive schemes rather than compromise their allegiance to Christ.
